title: How to Compare Browser and Website Access
overview: Help a reviewer support the Compare Browser and Website Access step without changing the workflow automatically.
checklist: Try the affected website in a private browsing window and in another available browser. Then try a second known working website. Record whether the failure follows one website, one browser, or all browser traffic.
common_indicators: Record the observed result and return to the originating workflow.

quiz.question: What should you do after completing this support step?
answers: Record the result and return to the workflow
